verdicts.reason: A: the black panel has shrunk to a small box mid-left that holds only 'MOVIE NIGHT' and empty divider lines. All the white copy (Groundhog Day, tagline, date, venue, URL) is scattered across the canvas on the busy white doodles and can't be read. B: the panel is a tiny box at the top with a microscopic 'MOVIE NIGHT', and every other line of white copy is jammed into a cluster over the illustration, the lines colliding with each other and unreadable. A is marginally less bad only because its 'MOVIE NIGHT' can still be read and its text lines don't stack on top of each other.
